top_categories.workout_context: 77 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Valley GranFondo's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Base fitness for Valley GranFondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Valley GranFondo. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Valley GranFondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At Valley GranFondo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 77 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Valley GranFondo's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 77 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,248ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.heat: June in Langley, Fraser Valley, BC, Canada — Early June in the Fraser Valley: mild, often sunny, with a real chance of a wet start given the region's Pacific climate. If the race forecast is hot, build heat exposure gradually before Valley GranFondo and rehearse an individualized drinking and electrolyte plan in training. Use your observed sweat response, product tolerance, and professional guidance where relevant instead of a fixed fluid or sodium prescription.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Valley GranFondo’s 77 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Endurance to prepare you for 77 miles of mixed terrain in Langley, Fraser Valley, BC, Canada.
